code_actions.rationale: Z99.11 denotes chronic ventilator dependence; the record documents emergent intubation and a prolonged ventilator course but no documentation that the patient was chronically ventilator dependent prior to admission. Discharge shows nasal cannula/trach-collar tolerance, not chronic pre-admission dependence.

There is no treating-provider documentation or stroke imaging/neurology consult in the retrieved record excerpts to validate an acute cerebral infarction; the active problem list and H&P do not include stroke as a documented diagnosis.
The record documents debridement to the fascial plane but does not explicitly document excision of skeletal muscle; muscle excision code is not supported by the retrieved operative/consult notes.

Nursing and discharge documentation explicitly describe a split-thickness skin graft (STSG). The billed PCS indicates full-thickness autologous replacement, which contradicts the clinical documentation.

Post-operative anemia requiring transfusion is documented, but the record excerpts do not specify platelet transfusion (type of transfusion unspecified); platelet transfusion code is unsupported without specific documentation.

discharge_disposition: 63 - Discharged/transferred to a Medicare-certified long-term care hospital (LTCH)

evidence.quote: CT scan confirmed necrotizing fasciitis of the right thigh, and emergent surgical consultation was obtained.

Interval: MICU admission with severe DKA (pH 6.98, bicarbonate 5, anion gap 34) and concurrent necrotizing fasciitis of right thigh; emergent surgical debridement performed with extensive tissue removal to fascia; septic shock with vasopressors; intubated for respiratory failure NAEON; cont current Rx 2/2 critical illness.

Sepsis and DKA bundles activated. Aggressive volume resuscitation with normal saline. Insulin infusion initiated. Broad-spectrum antimicrobials with clindamycin. Emergent CT identified necrotizing fasciitis. Surgical consultation obtained with immediate operating room availability. Intubation for airway protection and respiratory failure. Vasopressor support with norepinephrine.
Indication for Procedure: Respiratory failure from DKA and septic shock
Chest Radiograph, Portable AP: Bilateral opacities compatible with ARDS. See the Diagnostic Imaging section for the full report.

The course was complicated by ARDS with successful prone positioning, contrast-induced AKI managed conservatively without RRT, mucus plugging requiring bronchoscopy, and profound ICU-acquired weakness.
Split-thickness skin graft placement; foam bolster in place.
followed by successful split-thickness skin graft on ICU day 18 with excellent graft take.

Active Problem List # Problem 1 Severe diabetic ketoacidosis (initial pH 6.98, bicarbonate 5) 2 Necrotizing fasciitis of right thigh (Type II - Group A Strep + MRSA) 3 Septic shock with multi-organ dysfunction 4 Emergency surgical debridement x3 with wound VAC therapy 5 Split-thickness skin graft to right thigh 6 Acute respiratory failure with ARDS - resolved 7 Contrast-induced acute kidney injury (KDIGO 2), non-dialysis 8 SGLT2-inhibitor-associated euglycemic DKA (contributing factor) 9 Diabetic ketoacidosis with anion gap 34 10 Type 2 diabetes mellitus, uncontrolled (A1c 12.4%) 11 Hypertension 12 Hyperlipidemia 13 Diabetic peripheral neuropathy 14 Post-operative anemia requiring transfusion 15 ICU-acquired weakness 16 Post-operative delirium
Admission Orders Admit: MICU. Condition: critical. Vitals: continuous telemetry, arterial-line BP, SpO2; hourly assessment; strict I/O.
CT Right Thigh with IV Contrast: Necrotizing fasciitis of the right thigh with gas in the fascial planes.

system_note: Audit of MR_21 (DRG) - what was billed and what the medical record supports, with citations. Summary of key determinations - Necrotizing fasciitis (M72.6), severe sepsis with septic shock (R65.21), acute respiratory failure with hypoxia (J96.01), and ARDS (J80) are supported by the record and meet the policies' validation criteria: imaging/operative confirmation for necrotizing fasciitis, documented vasopressor use and markedly elevated lactate for septic shock, provider documentation plus objective oxygenation/ventilation data for respiratory failure and ARDS (evidence: H&P p.20, Critical Care Progress Note p.876, ED Note p.20, Infectious Diseases consult p.724, Nephrology consult p.713). Evidence: ev_0001, ev_0002, ev_0003, ev_0004, ev_0005, ev_0006, ev_0007. - I63.9 (cerebral infarction, billed POA=Y, MCC) is NOT supported in the treating-provider documentation retrieved: the admitting H&P and problem list enumerate DKA, necrotizing fasciitis, septic shock, surgical debridements, STSG, ARDS, AKI and post-op anemia but do not document an acute cerebral infarction or stroke workup/imaging to meet I63.- validation criteria; remove I63.9. Evidence: ev_0010. - Z99.11 (dependence on respirator) is not supported as a pre-existing/chronic dependence diagnosis on this record. The chart documents emergent intubation on admission and a prolonged ventilator course, later tracheostomy-related care / trach-collar tolerance and oxygen by nasal cannula at transfer - but no provider documentation that the patient was chronically dependent on a ventilator prior to admission (Z99.11 is for long-term dependence). Remove Z99.11. Evidence: ev_0005, ev_0009. - Procedure 0HRJX73 (replacement of right upper leg skin with autologous tissue substitute, full thickness) is contradicted by contemporaneous nursing and operative-course documentation that a split-thickness skin graft (STSG), not a full-thickness/autologous full-thickness replacement, was performed (nursing note: Split-thickness skin graft placement; discharge summary: successful split-thickness skin graft on ICU day 18). Remove 0HRJX73. Evidence: ev_0008, ev_0009. (& in the record flagged this exact discrepancy; auditor relied on the clinical notes stating STSG.) - Procedure 0KBQ0ZZ (excision of right upper leg muscle) is not explicitly documented. The surgical/operative documentation (General Surgery consult and Critical Care progress) documents debridement to the fascial plane and extensive fascial involvement, but the record excerpts provided do not document removal/excision of muscle tissue. Remove 0KBQ0ZZ. Evidence: ev_0002, ev_0013. - Procedure 30280B1 (transfusion of nonautologous platelets) is not specifically documented in the retrieved notes. The problem list/discharge references "post-operative anemia requiring transfusion" but the record does not document platelets specifically (type of transfusion unspecified). Remove 30280B1. Evidence: ev_0012. What was kept (examples tied to policy): - M72.6 (Necrotizing fasciitis) - policy requires imaging or operative confirmation of fascial-plane necrosis or operative findings; CT showed gas in fascial planes and the operative/ICU notes document emergent debridement to fascia and serial debridements (criteria satisfied). Evidence: ev_0001, ev_0002. - R65.21 (Severe sepsis with septic shock) - policy requires provider documentation of septic shock plus vasopressor use and elevated lactate or equivalent; ED + ICU notes document septic shock, norepinephrine vasopressor support, and lactate 8.6 mmol/L on presentation. Evidence: ev_0003, ev_0004. - J96.01 (Acute respiratory failure with hypoxia) - provider documentation of respiratory failure with objective oxygenation/ventilation and intubation is present (ED/Procedure Note and ABG/P-F values), satisfying the J96.01 criteria. Evidence: ev_0005,. - J80 (ARDS) - policy requires ARDS risk factor (sepsis), bilateral opacities and oxygenation impairment; documentation shows sepsis, later chest imaging compatible with ARDS, severe P/F impairment (P/F 75) and ARDS management (proning), and provider/discharge notes documenting ARDS. Evidence: ev_0006, ev_0007,. Discharge disposition (explicit from the record): Transfer to a long-term acute care hospital for continued wound care, rehabilitation and diabetes management (Transfer Instructions / Discharge Summary, 2027-01-05). Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n1218 and NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n1222 ( used below for PICC supporting procedure). See evidence_cited for exact quotes and pages. Audit actions taken (claim-level correction summary): - Remove diagnoses: I63.9, Z99.11 - unsupported by provider documentation meeting policy criteria (I63.9 absent from provider problem list and stroke workup; Z99.11 documents chronic ventilator dependence absent). Evidence: ev_0010, ev_0009, ev_0005. - Keep principal diagnosis M72.6 (Necrotizing fasciitis) in position 1 - operative and imaging confirmation present that meets M72.6 validation criteria. Evidence: ev_0001, ev_0002. - Remove procedures: 0HRJX73 (full-thickness skin replacement), 0KBQ0ZZ (muscle excision), 30280B1 (platelet transfusion) - not documented as performed per operative/nursing notes and problem list details. Evidence: ev_0008, ev_0009, ev_0002, ev_0013, ev_0012. Auditor conclusions & next steps - This claim is a Finding because multiple billed lines are not supported as submitted and require removal (procedural technique mismatch and one unsupported diagnosis). The principal diagnosis sequencing (M72.6 in position 1) is supported by operative/imaging documentation and may remain as principal. Corrected diagnosis and procedure lists are provided below. - No human escalation (HITL) is requested: the record excerpts give clear support for the changes (contradictory billing entries were explicitly flagged in the record and the provider notes resolve them in favor of the clinical documentation). Key citations (document / section / page are shown in evidence_cited entries): ev_0001, ev_0002, ev_0003, ev_0004, ev_0005, ev_0006, ev_0007, ev_0008, ev_0009, ev_0010, ev_0011, ev_0012, ev_0013.
rationale_letter: To: Medical Records/Coding Department From: Clinical Audit - DRG Review Team Re: Claim MR_21 (Admission 08/14/2026) - Audit Determination and Required Corrections We reviewed the full inpatient episode for MR_21 against the governing DRG coding policies and the treating-provider medical record. Our review found that several billed diagnosis and procedure lines are not supported by the clinical documentation and must be corrected. Below is a concise statement of the Finding, the clinical basis, the policy basis relied upon, and the corrective action required. Finding (summary) The record supports necrotizing fasciitis with operative confirmation, septic shock, acute respiratory failure and ARDS. However, the following billed items are unsupported or miscoded and must be removed from the claim: I63.9 (cerebral infarction, unspecified), Z99.11 (dependence on respirator), PCS 0HRJX73 (replacement of right upper leg skin with autologous tissue substitute, full thickness), PCS 0KBQ0ZZ (excision of right upper leg muscle), and PCS 30280B1 (transfusion of nonautologous platelets). These items either lack provider documentation meeting the policy validation criteria or are contradicted by operative/nursing documentation. Basis (what we relied on) - Necrotizing fasciitis (M72.6) meets the policy validation criteria: CT of the right thigh identified gas in the fascial planes and the operative/ICU documentation records emergent surgical debridement with extensive tissue removal to the fascial plane (see ED Provider Note and H&P: CT confirmed necrotizing fasciitis; Critical Care Progress Note: emergent surgical debridement with extensive tissue removal to fascia). (Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n9; NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n11.) - Severe sepsis with septic shock (R65.21) is supported by provider documentation of septic shock, vasopressor therapy (norepinephrine), and markedly elevated lactate on presentation (lactate 8.6 mmol/L), satisfying the policy's septic shock pathway requirements. (Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n8; NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n9.) - Acute respiratory failure (J96.01) and ARDS (J80) are supported by the treatment course: emergent intubation for respiratory failure, ABG and P/F data demonstrating severe hypoxemia (P/F ~75), radiographic correlation for ARDS, and ARDS-specific management (prone positioning). (Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n17; NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n11; NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n43; NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n1222.) - I63.9 (Cerebral infarction) - the treating-provider problem list, H&P and consult notes do not document an acute ischemic stroke or the imaging/neurology workup required to validate I63.- under the stroke validation policy. The problem list and assessments list DKA, necrotizing fasciitis, septic shock, serial debridements, STSG, ARDS and AKI but do not document stroke or stroke-specific imaging/neurology consultation. Therefore I63.9 is unsupported. (Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n9.) - Z99.11 (dependence on respirator) - this code denotes chronic/long-term dependence on ventilator at baseline. The chart documents emergent intubation and a prolonged ventilator course with later tracheostomy-related care, but there is no documentation that the patient was chronically ventilator dependent prior to admission; as such, Z99.11 is not supported and should be removed. (Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n17; NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n1222.) - PCS 0HRJX73 (full-thickness skin replacement) - contemporaneous nursing documentation and the discharge summary specifically describe a split-thickness skin graft (STSG), not a full-thickness replacement. The nursing progress note documents: "Split-thickness skin graft placement; foam bolster in place." The discharge summary likewise documents a successful split-thickness skin graft on ICU day 18. Thus the billed full-thickness autologous skin replacement code is a technique mismatch to the operative course and must be removed. (Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n125; NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n1222.) - PCS 0KBQ0ZZ (excision of muscle) - the operative/consultation documentation describes debridement to the fascial plane but does not explicitly document excision of muscle tissue. The record supports subcutaneous/fascial debridement; it does not document muscle excision required to support 0KBQ0ZZ. Remove 0KBQ0ZZ unless the provider produces the operative report documenting muscle excision. (Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n11; NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n12.) - PCS 30280B1 (platelet transfusion) - the record documents post-operative anemia requiring transfusion but does not document a platelet transfusion specifically; the type of transfusion is not specified in the retrieved notes. Remove 30280B1 unless specific documentation of platelet transfusion is provided. (Evidence: NOTE-Medical-Records-16-30-MR_21.pdf-n9.) Corrective action being applied by this audit - Remove diagnoses: I63.9; Z99.11 - Keep M72.6 as principal diagnosis (position 1) - Keep supported diagnoses including R65.21, J96.01, J80 and the documented diabetes and comorbid codes shown in the revised diagnosis list below - Remove unsupported procedure codes: 0HRJX73, 0KBQ0ZZ, 30280B1 - Keep supported procedure codes for endotracheal intubation, debridement of subcutaneous tissue/fascia, central venous infusion device, arterial monitoring device insertion, and prolonged mechanical ventilation >96 hours; see the revised procedure list below. If you disagree with these corrections, please provide the specific operative report(s), transfusion documentation, or neurology/stroke imaging/consultation that documents the removed items within 30 days so we may re-open the review and consider recoding. Sincerely, Clinical Audit Team (References: provider documentation quoted in evidence_cited attached to this determination.)
